newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Dow Chemical eyes Argentine venture-paper.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical eyes Argentine venture-paper.

text.p: U.S. firm Dow Chemical Co may join a $470-million venture between Argentina's YPF SA and Brazil's Petrobras to build a gas separation plant in Argentina, a daily reported Tuesday.
"We are analyzing the possibility of participating in the project," the president of Dow's subsidiary Dow Quimica Argentina Oscar Vignart told El Cronista in an interview.
But Vignart added that the project would not fall within Dow's main area of interest and that the firm would probably not take more than a six or seven percent share if it decided to take part.

YPF and state-owned Petrobras plan to build the plant in the city of Bahia Blanca. It would produce 650,000 tonnes a year of liquid petroleum gas, 200,000 tonnes of gasoline and 500,000 tonnes of ethane from the year 2000.
Dow owns part of the nearby Polo Petroquimico Bahia Blanca plant, which consumes large quantities of ethane and is expanding output.
